script.title: Pelican Pedal Express
script.description: A jaunty sailor pelican rides a scarlet bicycle, black-tipped wings gripping the handlebars and enormous webbed feet working opposite pedals. Its sweeping golden bill and deep orange throat pouch lead the silhouette.
